messages:
Emily: Pager — seeing ~10-15% 504s on streaming generation in US-WEST; routing fallback is flapping. Paging @sanjay_oncall

incident-bot: Alert created: STREAM-GEN-504 spike (priority: P1) — paging sanjay_oncall

Sanjay: I'm on it. ETA 5m to triage. @Maya can you join?

Maya: joining. quick check: logs show a routing loop between router-a -> router-b, KV cache hits dropping. Reproducing locally.

Emily: need initial status for customers — drafting below, pls review:

lina-comms: please paste draft

Emily:
```
We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting streaming generation in US-WEST, resulting in delayed and failed streamed responses for some customers. Our engineers are actively investigating and applying mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes. A subset of requests may experience increased latency or failures. No data loss expected.
```

lina-comms: => tweak: remove "data loss" claim (legal). Suggest: \"No user data was modified.\" Also add next update ETA.

legal: Avoid root-cause language. Recommend: \"We are actively investigating and implementing mitigations.\"

Sanjay: Ops update: we've pinned routing to fallback-v2, rolled back a recent router config (link: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/ab12cd), and restarted route-proxy on two nodes. Flushing KV cache now (progress 40%).

Maya: adding temporary rate cap for streaming sessions -> `max_conns=200` applied. Observing error rate drop to ~6%.

Emily: updated draft below. If no objections publish in 2 mins.

Emily:
```
We are currently investigating an increase in 5xx errors impacting streaming generation in US-WEST. Some streaming requests may see higher latency or failures. Our on-call team has applied mitigations: routing pinned to a safe variant, a rollback to the previous router config, and a KV cache flush. 
We will provide another update at +15 minutes or sooner. Customers experiencing impact should reach out to support with request IDs.
```

lina-comms: looks good. Adding a short customer-facing bullet list and action for support.

support: Copy for support console:
"Affected: streaming generation requests in US-WEST. Mitigation: routing pinned and cache flush in progress. ETA for next update: 15m. If you have live sessions, try reconnecting."

incident-bot: /statuspage create draft -> ID sp-7573

Sanjay: go ahead and publish. I've confirmed mitigations holding for 2 mins.

lina-comms: publishing now. /statuspage publish sp-7573

incident-bot: Statuspage update published: sp-7573 (URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/sp-7573). Notifying subscribers.

Emily: thanks team. I'll monitor and collect metrics for next update.

--- 15 minutes later ---

Maya: periodic update: error rate down to 2.5%, KV flush complete, no evidence of data corruption. Continuing to observe for 30m before full resolve.

Emily: new update draft that includes metrics and next steps:

Emily:
```
Update: Error rate has decreased from ~15% to 2.5% after mitigations (routing pin, rollback, KV flush). We are monitoring stability for the next 30 minutes. No customer data has been modified. Post-incident analysis and root cause will be shared when available.
```

legal: remove \"root cause\" phrasing until postmortem done. Suggest "post-incident analysis" is fine.

lina-comms: publishing periodic update.

incident-bot: Statuspage update published: sp-7573 (update 2)

--- 45 minutes later ---

Maya: holding stable for 35+ mins, error rate ~0.1%. Rolling back temporary caps and keeping routing pinned for controlled rollout.

Sanjay: marking incident as resolved in statuspage. Draft resolve message:

Sanjay:
```
Resolved: The increased 5xx error rate affecting streaming generation in US-WEST has been resolved. Mitigations (routing rollback and KV cache flush) reduced errors and service is stable. We will follow up with a post-incident report.
```

lina-comms: small wording tweak: avoid implying definitive root cause. Replace \"resolved\" header ok but in body say \"service returned to normal\".

incident-bot: Statuspage update published: sp-7573 (resolved)

support: Notifying top-tier customers and CS.

Emily: great work. Filing postmortem runbook and tagging for follow-up: owners @Maya, @Sanjay, timeline + remediation checklist.

Maya: I'll own the postmortem. Adding initial blameless timeline notes.

Sanjay: closing thread. If anything flares, reopen and republish.

-- end --
